description: Eight ramps and eight triangles running at one rate, each an eighth of a cycle apart, for building Shepard tones out of eight oscillators and eight VCAs

params.text: Attenuverts the rate CV before it is added to the RATE knob
Sets the rate of the sweep, doubling for each step up the scale, from one cycle in 256 seconds to 1024Hz
Scales every saw output, between silence and the full 0-10V ramp
Scales every triangle output, between silence and the full 0-10V triangle

inputs.text: Voltage control over the rate, attenuverted and added to the RATE knob

outputs.text: A rising 0-10V ramp at its own point in the cycle, the eight ramps being spaced an eighth of a cycle apart; intended for an oscillator's pitch input
A 0-10V triangle at its own point in the cycle, the eight triangles being spaced an eighth of a cycle apart; intended for a VCA's level input
All eight ramps on one cable, one to a channel
All eight triangles on one cable, one to a channel

notes: slow rates and linear VCAs give the clearest rising or falling illusion
